answer: Every juror's verdict is re-sampled one layer up — audited against seeded honeypot answers and the consensus of other established panels. Approve a planted fake and it flashes like a beacon to the meta-jury above, which slashes the bond and suspends the colluding ring; who audits whom reshuffles each epoch, so no clique crosses the same canyon twice. To farm fake approvals an attacker must corrupt the graders AND the freshly-drawn meta-graders over them — a quorum at every tier — or be cracked open like a walnut the first honeypot that slips past. Cost scales per tier, not per clone.
